reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the list price of the version before it
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), cuts AS (
  -- one row per price cut from 1 to 28 February 2025, with the Monday of its week
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur < prev_price
    AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
)
SELECT c.product_id, c.valid_from,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start < c.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) / 8.0 AS avg_units_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start > c.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) / 8.0 AS avg_units_after
FROM cuts c
JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = c.product_id
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN c.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND c.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY
GROUP BY c.product_id, c.valid_from

WITH cuts AS (
  -- one row per price cut from 1 to 28 February 2025, with the Monday of its week
  SELECT h.product_id, h.valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', h.valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM price_history h
  JOIN price_history p ON p.product_id = h.product_id AND p.valid_to = h.valid_from - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  WHERE h.list_price_eur < p.list_price_eur AND h.valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
)

WITH versions AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), cuts AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur < prev_price AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
)
SELECT r.product_id, r.valid_from,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start < r.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) / 8.0 AS avg_units_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start > r.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) / 8.0 AS avg_units_after
FROM cuts r JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = r.product_id
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN CAST(r.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AS DATE) AND CAST(r.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY AS DATE)
GROUP BY r.product_id, r.valid_from
